children: The seven-day rally seen by the Nifty has seen the index jump from levels of 22,500 to past 25,000 levels by the time trading closed on Friday. From making new lows early-October, the Nifty is now at a nine-month high, with the largecap stocks finally coming to the party. The two biggest index heavyweights, Reliance Industries and HDFC Bank, both gained between 13% to 14% during the last week, turning out to be the biggest contributors to the Nifty rally. In fact, 14 Nifty constituents managed to gain 10% or more during the week gone by. Today's Mahurat trading session will be between 2:15 PM to 3:30 PM. Experts are a little more optimistic of Samvat 2083 after the turn of events in the previous Samvat. The Nasdaq did stage a small bounce on Friday, although the Dow continued to see selling pressure on Wall Street. Earnings season is more or less done with, and the focus will shift back to global developments.

Stay tuned to this space for all the Live updates during the Mahurat trading session, with special guest commentary, market trivia, and of course, recommendations for the new Samvat too. Watch this space for all the Live updates.
